quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn where both intersecting highways are one-way, both the approach for the left turn and the left turn must be made as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the highway.

activation.condition: Vehicle intends a left turn at an intersection where both intersecting highways are one-way.

obligation.description: Both approach and left turn must be made as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge of the highway.

timing.description: Measure approach separately from the left turn and leaving-intersection interval.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge on approach
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain source one-way directionality and original approach body-to-left-curb geometry; no legal numeric cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as close as practicable to the left-hand curb or edge through the turn
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain original leaving-intersection body-to-destination-left-curb geometry; no legal numeric cutoff.
